title: Lee Designs GP Mono Street TC-3

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Built for aggressive dirt performance, the Troy Lee Designs GP Mono Street TC-3 is delivers competition-grade off-road impact absorption with maximum cooling throughput across punishing tracks and trails. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell tips the scales at a featherweight 1314g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~100 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting DOT, ECE 22.06 impact standards. An ultra-breathable, antimicrobial interior liner stabilizes the helmet during aggressive terrain vibration, locked in securely with track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Solid color version of the GP for riders who prefer clean aesthetics.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for aggressive street riding and dirt track use; features a mono-shell construction with TC-3 technology for impact absorption.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Troy Lee Designs GP Mono Street TC-3: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

introduction: Positioned in Troy's Dirt / MX lineup, the Lee Designs GP Mono Street TC-3 brings Global Premium engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The Troy Lee Designs GP Mono Street TC-3 represents Troy's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~100 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Dirt / MX helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Troy Lee Designs GP Mono Street TC-3 delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
